canon.heavens: the airless surface of the moon seen close above it -- grey lunar rock and crater fields curving away to a hard black horizon, black star-scattered space beyond, raw unfiltered sunlight, no atmosphere, no clouds, no blue sky, no ground, no earth, no vegetation, no ruins, no people, no human figures, no astronauts, no crowds
canon.interior: the space behind the openings, inside the moon -- a colossal squared void cut from grey lunar rock, ruled courses and flat dressed faces running away beyond sight in every direction, the openings themselves small and far above, raw unfiltered sunlight standing in hard-edged shafts through them, black airless dark where the light does not reach, no atmosphere, no earth, no sky, no vegetation, no water, no people, no human figures, no astronauts, no ornament, no furniture, no modern objects
canon.chambers: a colossal bare mountain of hard grey rock standing alone in an empty western wilderness -- cut deep into its face four enormous smooth hollow places, each one hundreds of feet across, their walls dressed and polished and completely bare, dry open desert running to the horizon, hard low sun, no ornament, no carving, no markings, no steps, no doors, no buildings, no city, no structures, no ruins, no vegetation, no modern objects
canon.ascent: the void between the earth and the moon -- black airless space, scattered stars, the bright curve of the earth far below, no ground, no horizon line, no buildings
canon.winds: the rim at the ends of the earth -- a colossal wall of dressed cut stone standing across the edge of the world, ranked enormous square openings cut through it, wind pouring out of them in visible torrents of dust and driven cloud, the open land running away below for hundreds of miles, blazing raw daylight, no buildings, no city, no structures, no ruins, no modern objects, no people, no human figures
canon.mountains: seven colossal peaks standing far above an ordinary mountain range -- their summits impossibly high and white with hard frost, the ordinary ranges small and dark far beneath them, cloud lying well below their shoulders, open wilderness running away to the horizon, blazing clean daylight, no buildings, no city, no structures, no roads, no modern objects
canon.rivers: seven enormous rivers crossing a flat open plain -- each one miles wide, running away to a bright sea at the horizon, the ordinary rivers thin threads beside them, flat empty country, blazing clean daylight, no buildings, no city, no bridges, no boats, no modern objects
canon.field: an ancient terraced barley field on an Ethiopian hillside -- dry stone terraces, standing grain, the highland falling away for miles beyond, open bright sky, no buildings, no city, no structures, no modern objects
canon.horizon: a bare east-facing skyline seen from an Ethiopian highland ridge -- a long low rock ridgeline running flat across the middle of the frame, dry scrub and scattered pale boulders on the near ground, open empty wilderness, no buildings, no city, no structures, no ruins, no modern objects
canon.chapel: a stone chapel cut into an Ethiopian highland cliff -- pale dressed basalt, one high opening, a plain wooden reading stand, no windows, no ornament, no modern objects
canon.highland: an Ethiopian highland escarpment -- bare rock, dry scrub, the land falling away for miles, no buildings, no city, no structures
canon.hermon: the snow-streaked summit of Mount Hermon -- bare grey rock, thin cloud, open wilderness, no buildings, no city, no structures
canon.ridge: a bare highland ridgeline at night -- dry scrub, scattered pale boulders, one low stone wall, open wilderness, no buildings, no city, no modern objects
canon.cave: the Qumran cliffs above the Dead Sea -- pale limestone riddled with dark cave mouths, dry scree, the salt sea flat and bright below, open desert, no buildings, no modern objects
canon.babylon: the Mesopotamian plain at Babylon -- a colossal stepped ziggurat of mud brick rising over flat river country, palms and dust, open sky, no modern objects
canon.limb: the airless surface of the moon seen close above it -- grey lunar rock and crater fields curving away to a hard black horizon, black star-scattered space beyond, a small distant earth low on the horizon far beyond the limb, raw unfiltered sunlight, no atmosphere, no clouds, no blue sky, no ground, no vegetation, no ruins, no people, no human figures, no astronauts, no crowds, no galaxy, no nebula
